name: Temperature sweep three runs
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cd ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/asm && S=$(echo ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--google--gemma-3-270m-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized/snapshots/*/model.safetensors) && for T in 500 700 1000; do printf "Hello\n" | timeout 150 ./core $S ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/vocab.bin 2 c ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/bpe.bin $T 950 > /tmp/sweep$T.log 2>&1; echo "T$T-EXIT=$?"; done; for T in 500 700 1000; do echo "== T$T:"; awk "/chat ready/{f=1} f" /tmp/sweep$T.log | wc -l; done'
